name: MapMode
meaning: g_map.mode (+0x54), the sub-mode while SelectMenuState == 3. Bit 0x80 marks a transient mode that auto-advances to pendingMode after 150 ms of autoRepeatMs.

name: MAP_MODE_ITEM_LIST
meaning: cursor moves over the inventory rows; CROSS enters the action row

name: MAP_MODE_ACTION_ROW
meaning: cursor moves over HELP/USE/COMBINE/EXIT; CROSS performs the action

name: MAP_MODE_COMBINE_PICK
meaning: a first item has been latched into combinePartnerIndex and the second is being chosen

name: MAP_MODE_HELP_SCROLL
meaning: UP/DOWN scroll the long description text (0x539965)

name: MAP_MODE_F_TRANSIENT
meaning: MapMode doc: bit 0x80 marks a transient mode (BeginModeTransition sets it, UpdateState auto-advances)
